review:
Theoretically speaking, this seems to be a handy little doo-dad/gizmo/thingamabob for the well-organized/obsessive-compulsive traveler, but please take note of the following pros and cons.

Pros:

1. It gives you a fairly accurate preview of the weight of your luggage (+/- a few ounces) saving you the irritation of arriving at the airline counter with over-heavy luggage, and having to repack and shuffle potentially embarrassing items around in full view of the other passengers.

2. You can use the tape measure to verify that your carry-on luggage will fit in the overhead compartment, or under the seat.  This saves you from participating in the dreaded and ruthless shoving tournament of the skies, where people try to stuff bags the size of newborn elephants into the overhead lockers.

Cons:

1. It has the capacity to weigh suitcases up to 75 lbs, but when you're traveling alone, it's very awkward to lift a suitcase even half that weight with your arms extended (so that it doesn't touch your body) and still read the tiny numbers on the dial. 

2. The handle is small and "ergonometrically-challenged", and people who can't lift a 50 lb suitcase with one outstretched hand will find it very difficult to get two hands in there.  Even if you do manage to get this far, you won't be able to hold it for long before the handle sinks deep into your palm, cutting you a new lifeline.

3. You need to try to balance the suitcase by centering the hook on the suitcase handle, but if you lift too quickly, the hook slips to one side, causing possible grievous bodily harm as the suitcase comes down on your toe.

4. Another hook problem - you can see that the hook is an open design. If you are lifting the suitcase, the hook can slip off on the way up, causing the suitcase to fall as in 3. above. Even worse, the momentum keeps your hand moving upwards, and not only can you give yourself a shiner or broken nose with the back of your hand, but the hook can swing up and jab you in the eye. (True story)


You can use it on lighter luggage without too many problems, but then again, if your luggage is light you have no need to fear the scale - do you?  On the surface this sounds like a great travel gadget, but beware of the pitfalls.


Amanda Richards, September 22, 200
note: The scale and tape measure sound useful. In practice, the handle is hard to grip and it's awkward to hold up a suitcase while reading the dial.

review:
I have these in black, and while I find them to go with just about every outfit I wear to work, I wish they were just a little (read: quite a lot) less uncomfortable. Firstly, the insole provided doesn't seem to fit the inside of the shoe properly. Almost like it's too wide. My foot is neither narrow nor wide, so this isn't something I typically notice about a shoe. There is an arch, but because of the weirdly shaped insole it doesn't provide any support. The zig zap strap is a really cute feature that I love, but it just adds to the uncomfort of the shoe. You can tighten the strap to keep your foot from sliding around inside, but then it cuts off circulation and leaves painful imprints. If you leave it too loose then you leave your feet pretty unstable. 

All in all, a versatile mary jane with good looks but no comfort
note: The shoes go with a lot of outfits, but the insole doesn't sit right and the strap digs in. The buyer sums them up as good-looking and uncomfortable.

review:
When you buy Natori you expect the best.  But this product just isn't up to their usual high standard.  Most disappointing is the elastic used at the leg and waist openings.  For 20 dollars they should be awesome.  They aren't.

My favorite panty right now is a Nordstrom brand boy short that is really comfortable and costs about 10 bucks.  I haven't seen them online, but this is worth a trip to the store
note: The buyer expected better from Natori, especially from the elastic. The cheaper pair they like is from a different brand.

review:
Yes, the bra runs small in the cup area.  However, that's what the bra is supposed to do.  I'm a D cup and this bra makes it possible to wear tighter fitted, button down shirts without the buttons bulging & making my chest feel like it's being crushed.  

Recommended for the larger chested folks
note: The cups run small, but the buyer wants that minimizing effect so their button-down shirts fit better. They recommend it.

review:
I really like this boot.  I wear a 7.5 and a 7.5 fit perfectly with a medium pair of socks.  I like the look.  I have wider calves so this was great for me, but might now work if you have thin calves.  

The only reason I didn't give it a five was because after a few wears the seam on the back of the boot split by the ankle. I went the the aerosoles website and called the service number.  It had been within a month (their guarantee) and so they sent me a new pair.  You have to ask to get the postage sent to you.  They were very nice and on the phone said this wasn't a normal occurrence, so  an exchange for the same boot was fine.
note: The boots fit and work well for wider calves. A seam split after a few wears, but the buyer still chose to exchange them for the same pair.

review: I used this pair to replace my regular large fins. Speedo fins worked quite effectively and gave me a good workout. The material is also good/strong. I have no gripes about this product. I will highly recommend to people who do not like to use regular-size fins
note: "No gripes" means the buyer is happy with the fins. They like the workout and the material and recommend them at the end.

review:
If your loved one is a beautiful 5'7", 130 lb slender lady like mine, forget about this piece of clothing. If, however, she is a 5'1" 180 lb gorgeous "petite" girl, this might just be the excitement inducer you are looking for. You'll have lots of fun, first trying to put it on her, then trying to use the slits which are in all the wrong places, and then finally to remove it from her body without injuring her or yourself.

Fun that will come after that is purely optional..
note: The "fun" is a sarcastic way of describing how hard it is to put on and take off, with the slits in the wrong places.

review: This is really cute.  nice material.  my only unfavorable point is that the collar does not completely encircle the top of the jacket.It leaves a gap about 3/4" on each side of the zipper where the child's neck should be covered. Not heavy duty for outside colder weather but fine for traveling in the car. Its a good deal for the money.
note: The jacket is cute and good value, but the gaps at the collar make it better for the car than for really cold weather.

review: This shoe works as it is supposed to do.  I use it because instead of going barefoot when I have to go long distances, jog, or if I'm not sure that there aren't sharp stones, shells, or chards of glass in the sand or on the pavements close to the beach.  The only problem is that the fabric/material picks up stains easily that do not come off
note: The shoes do what the buyer wanted near the beach and protect their feet. The material picking up stains is the one drawback.

review: you get what you pay for.  This bra is better than another cheaper version that I have tried.  Not the easiest latch/unlatch feature on the nursing cup.  But other than that it is comfy
note: The nursing clasp is awkward, but the bra is comfortable and the buyer prefers it to the cheaper one they tried.

review: I had no problem with the purchase xcept it didn't have elastic so I had to use seam tape and iron them so they be shorte
note: The buyer says the purchase was fine overall, though the lack of elastic meant they had to shorten the items themselves with seam tape.

review:
Bra was more padded than I thought when ordering.  Descriptions of products are not adequate.
thanks, though...love shopping on Amazo
note: The bra was more padded than expected and the buyer found the description lacking. The positive comment at the end is about shopping on Amazon.

review:
Based on the prior reviews, I fully expected to like these. Unfortunately, I don't, and won't buy more. They don't stay up. I don't have particularly large or small calves, and don't have that issue with my other athletic socks. Oh, well, buy and learn.

I bought both white and black and they are equally disappointing
note: The buyer expected to like the socks based on other reviews, but neither color stayed up and they wouldn't buy more.

review: It seems that this pair of soccer shoes is quite simple, nothing special designed. But it is not expensive though...
note: The shoes are basic, but the buyer gives them some credit for being inexpensive. It's mild approval.

review:
I do like this t-shirt.  I liked the organic cotton and the general style.  But I will never buy American Apparel again.  Not only are they VERY labor and union unfriendly, their ads exploitive of young girls (I mean, I can tolerate some of the young models in general, but these are particularly young girls in amature porn-looking situations), but a friend's daughter had a particularly unsavory experience working in one of their stores.  

I know I can find a cosy organic shirt elsewhere.  ick
note: The buyer likes the shirt's cotton and style, but says they won't buy from the brand again because of its labor practices and ads.

review: I purchased these boots in the middle of January thinking I could use them this winter because I live in Colorado and often visit the mountains. When I received them I was disappointed because they were too small but I thought I would try them anyways. After about two days they started to stretch out and now I am in love with them
note: The boots felt too small when they arrived. They stretched after a couple of days, and the buyer says they love them now.

review:
I was pressured into buying this flip case by a Radioshack employee and it turned out to be a great case.  Although it doesn't completely cover every surface of the ipod (you can see the sides a little near the top), it protects most of the ipod from scratches and smudges.  The leather on this case is soft to the touch.  The flip-design is nice, and the magnets work much better than a snap or velcro would - I was also wary of the magnets screwing up my harddrive, but I haven't had a problem with it.

One more thing: the belt clip is a piece of leather on the back with velcro and a snap, so there is a chance that it could get ripped off of your belt if you are doing some wild activity while wearing your ipod on your belt.  I just keep mine in my pocket
note: The buyer felt pressured to buy it, but ended up liking the case. Some edges are exposed and the belt clip has limits, though it still protects most of the iPod.

review: I had bought these for my boy thinking they had a fly front much like the mens versions I wear. They are my son's least favorite underwear mearly cause he has to pull the front of them down in order to use the bath room. He's only 6 and when I had trained him I tought him to use the fly on the front of his underwear. In my personal thoughts are that men's/boy's underwear has a fly in the front for need use, unlike that for women and girls whom don't require it
note: The buyer expected a fly opening. Without one, their son finds the underwear inconvenient to use and likes it least.

review: While you might like this bag as a shoulder bag, the adjustable straps do not work well as a backpack
note: It might work as a shoulder bag, but the adjustable straps don't work well when it's worn as a backpack.

review: I bought this as a Christmas gift for my fiancé. I looked all over for a money clip/wallet that had an actual clip - not just the magnetic clip. So needless to say I was thrilled when I found this one online. After my fiancé opened it up, he put his money in the clip. The clip is located in the middle of the wallet so you have to get creative and fold your money more than just in half. After using it for a few weeks, the pin in the clip fell out. He was able to fix it, but I would not be comfortable carrying money around in a faulty clip.
note: The buyer was excited to find a real money clip. The pin fell out after a few weeks, and even after fixing it they wouldn't trust it with cash.

review: Very fast shipping...received my item a week before schedule.  Product was the same as the website description, would purchase from again
note: It arrived a week early, matched the listing, and the buyer says they'd order from the seller again.

review: Well, I don't know about this. I know I feel real excited when I have these on and the girl in the mirror looks very wanton, very exciting. I know my guy Jack would love to see me in these, but they do give me the chilly willies, in a good way. One look at these and you know just what they were made for. Come to think of it, that's a good thing. I know I'll break them out on special occasions, in fact I can't think of a better way of making up then putting on this outfit, because no matter what I did, all would be forgiven the second Jack catches a glimpse of me in these. Five big stars from me
note: The opening sounds unsure, but the reviewer says the feeling is "in a good way" and gives the item five stars.
